text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whew.
I ran a whole bunch today too~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops! Before going to bed, gotta jot down today's lessons!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Ummm,
what I learned from today's training was—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh!
This is the last page!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Aw man.
I'll have to go buy a new one tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if I say so myself, it's packed to the brim.
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Especially since the Trainer came along, it's amazing.
The amount of notes has doubled.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
We'll have to thank them tomorrow.

The next day, a formal-looking Sakura Chiyono O
gave me some drinks as a gift of appreciation.
